title: COA flags ‘unverifiable’ SHS voucher beneficiaries that led to P938k overpayments
summary: The Commission on Audit flagged 58 “unverifiable” beneficiaries under the Senior High School Voucher Program, resulting in P938,000 in government overpayments.
